Method of Attack: Phishing site mimicking Citibank login page with convincing domain and TLS certificate
Requests personal information including full name, DOB, address, last four digits of SSN, debit card number, expiration date, and security code
Submits stolen data to attacker’s server
Attempts background login to Citibank using stolen credentials
Triggers OTP code sent by Citibank to victim’s phone and requests victim to enter OTP
Uses stolen credentials and OTP to take full control of victim’s account
Redirects victim to legitimate Citibank login page to avoid suspicion
Indicators of Compromise: phishing landing page mimicking Citibank login
Attack Vector: Phishing website accessed via unknown means (email or SMS suspected)
